knowledge:
- key_parameters: design=~ sample + exon + condition:exon=Formula used in DEXSeqDataSetFromSE and DEXSeqDataSetFromHTSeq to model sample-specific effects, exon-specific effects, and the interaction between condition and exon ;; fitExpToVar="condition"=Parameter in estimateExonFoldChanges() specifying which variable to use for calculating relative exon usage fold changes ;; reducedModel and fullModel=Formulas passed to testForDEU() to perform likelihood ratio tests for complex experimental designs ;; BPPARAM=Parameter in estimateDispersions(), testForDEU(), and estimateExonFoldChanges() to enable parallel processing via BiocParallel ;; norCounts=TRUE / splicing=TRUE=Parameters in plotDEXSeq() to plot normalized counts or splicing-specific changes (with overall gene expression subtracted)
- alternatives: HTSeq python scripts (dexseq_prepare_annotation.py and dexseq_count.py) or Rsubread package for read counting instead of summarizeOverlaps() ;; featureCounts() (via Vivek Bhardwaj's scripts) as an alternative to HTSeq for counting ;; diffSplice from limma, satuRn, or non-parametric approaches for datasets with a large number of samples (e.g., >20)
- when_to_use: When analyzing RNA-Seq data to detect differential exon usage (alternative splicing or isoform regulation) across different conditions, especially with small sample sizes.
- pitfalls: Aligning to the transcriptome instead of the genome (must use a splice-aware genome aligner like TopHat2, GSNAP, or STAR) ;; Using GTF files from sources other than Ensembl without converting them (non-Ensembl files may not adhere to the GTF standard and cause python preprocessing to fail) ;; Failing to specify correct strandedness (-s option in python script) or paired-end options (-p option) during read counting ;; Failing to sort SAM files by name or position for paired-end data ;; Overlapping genes on the same strand being aggregated by default (can be disabled with -r no)

workflows.name: r_based_bam_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform differential exon usage analysis starting from BAM files and a GTF annotation entirely within R.
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare annotation using makeTxDbFromGFF() and exonicParts() ;; 2. Count reads overlapping exonic parts using BamFileList() and summarizeOverlaps() ;; 3. Build a DEXSeqDataSet using DEXSeqDataSetFromSE() ;; 4. Estimate size factors using estimateSizeFactors() ;; 5. Estimate dispersions using estimateDispersions() ;; 6. Test for differential exon usage using testForDEU() ;; 7. Estimate exon fold changes using estimateExonFoldChanges() ;; 8. Extract results using DEXSeqResults()
workflows.code:
txdb = makeTxDbFromGFF("Drosophila_melanogaster.BDGP5.25.62.gtf.gz")
flattenedAnnotation = exonicParts( txdb, linked.to.single.gene.only=TRUE )
names(flattenedAnnotation) =
    sprintf("%s:E%0.3d", flattenedAnnotation$gene_id, flattenedAnnotation$exonic_part)
bamFiles = c( untreated1_chr4(), untreated3_chr4() )
bamFiles = BamFileList( bamFiles )
seqlevelsStyle(flattenedAnnotation) = "UCSC"
se = summarizeOverlaps(
    flattenedAnnotation, BamFileList(bamFiles), singleEnd=FALSE,
    fragments=TRUE, ignore.strand=TRUE )
colData(se)$condition = factor(c("untreated1", "untreated3"))
colData(se)$libType = factor(c("single-end", "paired-end"))
dxd = DEXSeqDataSetFromSE( se, design= ~ sample + exon + condition:exon )
dxd = estimateSizeFactors( dxd )
dxd = estimateDispersions( dxd )
dxd = testForDEU( dxd )
dxd = estimateExonFoldChanges( dxd, fitExpToVar="condition")
dxr1 = DEXSeqResults( dxd )

workflows.name: python_htseq_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform differential exon usage analysis starting from pre-calculated HTSeq count files and a flattened GFF file.
input: count_files (text files containing exon counts per sample)
flattened.gff (collapsed exon counting bins GFF file)
workflows.stages: 1. Define paths to count files and the flattened GFF file ;; 2. Create a sample metadata data frame ;; 3. Build a DEXSeqDataSet using DEXSeqDataSetFromHTSeq() ;; 4. Run the complete analysis using the wrapper function DEXSeq()
workflows.code:
inDir = system.file("extdata", package="pasilla")
countFiles = list.files(inDir, pattern="fb.txt$", full.names=TRUE)
flattenedFile = list.files(inDir, pattern="gff$", full.names=TRUE)
sampleTable = data.frame(
   row.names = c( "treated1", "treated2", "treated3", 
      "untreated1", "untreated2", "untreated3", "untreated4" ),
   condition = c("knockdown", "knockdown", "knockdown",  
      "control", "control", "control", "control" ),
   libType = c( "single-end", "paired-end", "paired-end", 
      "single-end", "single-end", "paired-end", "paired-end" ) )
dxd = DEXSeqDataSetFromHTSeq(
   countFiles,
   sampleData=sampleTable,
   design= ~ sample + exon + condition:exon,
   flattenedfile=flattenedFile )
dxr = DEXSeq(dxd)

workflows.name: complex_design_workflow
workflows.intent: Perform differential exon usage analysis controlling for additional technical or experimental covariates (blocking factors).
input: dxd (an existing DEXSeqDataSet containing covariate columns in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Define full and reduced model formulas incorporating the blocking factor ;; 2. Estimate dispersions using the full model formula ;; 3. Test for differential exon usage by comparing the full and reduced models ;; 4. Extract results using DEXSeqResults()
workflows.code:
formulaFullModel    =  ~ sample + exon + type:exon + condition:exon
formulaReducedModel =  ~ sample + exon + type:exon 
dxd = estimateDispersions( dxd, formula = formulaFullModel )
dxd = testForDEU( dxd, 
	reducedModel = formulaReducedModel, 
        fullModel = formulaFullModel )
dxr2 = DEXSeqResults( dxd )
